title: Agrobacterium-Mediated Transformation of Heterosigma akashiwo
author: Vinay K Nagarajan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.4ytgxwn

steps.title: Grow and harvest algal cells
steps.instruction: Cultivate Heterosigma akashiwo in f/2 medium at 22 °C with a 16 h light : 8 h dark cycle until the culture contains 5–10 ×10⁶ cells, then collect and wash the cells.

substeps.instruction: Grow algae in f/2 medium at 22 °C, 16 h light : 8 h dark until 5–10 ×10⁶ cells are present.
Collect cells in a round‑bottom tube (Oakridge) and centrifuge at 2,000 rpm for 2 min.
Gently rinse the pellet with f/2 medium and centrifuge again at 2,000 rpm for 2 min.

steps.title: Introduce binary vector into Agrobacterium
steps.instruction: Electroporate the plant binary vector (e.g., pCambia1300) into A. tumefaciens GV3101(pMP90), select on antibiotic plates, and confirm by PCR.

substeps.instruction: Electroporate pCambia1300 (or variant) into A. tumefaciens GV3101(pMP90).
Plate cells on agar‑solidified LB medium containing Kanamycin 50 µg/ml, Rifampicin 25 µg/ml, and Gentamycin 25 µg/ml; incubate at 29 °C for 2 days.
Identify positive colonies carrying the plasmid using PCR.

steps.title: Prepare Agrobacterium induction culture
steps.instruction: Grow a starter culture, expand it, induce vir genes with acetosyringone, and adjust the bacterial density for transformation.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate 5 ml LB broth with the verified Agrobacterium colony and appropriate antibiotics; grow overnight at 29 °C, 200 rpm.
Approximately 16–18 h before algal transformation, inoculate 25 ml LB broth with 25 µl of the starter culture; grow until OD₆₀₀ ≈ 1.5.
Pellet the culture at 9,000 rpm for 5 min.
Resuspend the pellet in half‑strength Guillard's f/2 medium containing 200 µM acetosyringone to reach a final OD₆₀₀ of 2–2.5.
Incubate the resuspended cells in the dark for 2 h at room temperature to activate vir genes.

steps.title: Co‑cultivate algae with Agrobacterium on agarose
steps.instruction: Combine algal and bacterial cells in a semi‑solid matrix and incubate for one day.

substeps.instruction: Mix 2–4 ×10⁶ algal cells with 18–25 ×10⁶ induced Agrobacterium cells in a total volume of 6–12 ml.
Layer the mixture onto a 0.25 % (w/v) agarose gel matrix in a suitable vessel.
Incubate the co‑culture at room temperature for 24 h.

steps.title: Recover algae post‑co‑cultivation
steps.instruction: Separate algal cells from the matrix, wash, and culture them in cefotaxime‑supplemented medium for five days.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the co‑culture at 2,000 rpm for 2 min to collect the algal pellet.
Rinse the pellet twice with f/2 medium.
Resuspend the cells in 20–40 ml f/2 medium supplemented with Cefotaxime 150 µg/ml.
Dispense 10 ml aliquots into sterile multi‑well plates and incubate under standard growth conditions for 5 days.

steps.title: Select transformants with hygromycin
steps.instruction: Expose the recovered algal cultures to hygromycin and cefotaxime for a week to select for transformed cells.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the algae to selection medium consisting of f/2 supplemented with Hygromycin 10–20 µg/ml and Cefotaxime 150 µg/ml.
Incubate at room temperature under standard growth conditions for 7 days.
